messages:
Rina Gomez: Hey team — Rina here, starting today as Product Designer (onboarding squad). Quick checklist: Figma access, where the onboarding roadmap lives, and where we stash past interview synths. Any fast links?
Theo (Design Lead): Welcome Rina! :tada: Which email did you sign up with? I'll invite you to the Design org and point you at the onboarding files.
Rina Gomez: rina.gomez@redwood.com. Also curious if we have a canonical list of onboarding metrics or goals?
Olive_PM: Roadmap + metrics live in Notion: Product > Roadmap > Onboarding initiative. Metrics section has activation funnel + NPS targets. Happy to do a 15m sync tomorrow.
Sam (Research): We keep raw recordings + highlights in Dovetail, and synths + artifacts in Notion under Research > Syntheses. TL;DR policy: every synth needs a 3-bullet summary.
Iris_IT: Okta provision should be done. If Figma invite not in inbox, try https://okta.redwood.com/apps and search "Figma" then Request Access. If that fails, DM me and I'll force a resend.
Theo (Design Lead): Sent a Figma invite and added you to "Design - Onboarding" team. Canonical files: "Onboarding Components (library)" and "Onboarding Sprint Board" — accept library to get tokens.
onboard-bot: Automated: added Rina Gomez to "Design - Onboarding" team in Figma (pending acceptance).
Rina Gomez: Got the invite and joined. Saw two files: one labeled "Components - Onboarding" and another prototyping flow. Which should I edit?
Theo (Design Lead): Use Components for shared changes, prototype file for experiments. If updating components, ping Maya in DS for token sync.
Olive_PM: Also FYI: user research link in the roadmap has the latest usability test and a short list of open questions. Welcome aboard!
Rina Gomez: Thanks everyone — I'll skim docs and book the 15m. Appreciate the speedy setup :heart:
